description: Open Call #1 funds pilots operationalising at least one of the 4 EU Codes of Practice: intellectual assets, standardisation, industry–academia co-creation or citizen engagement . 
 Strand A: onboarding, configuration, staff training and real-case testing of the AI-enabled Toolbox.
 Strand B: cross-border secondments between two KVIs, with an individual skills upgrade and an organisational outcome. 
 Strand C: both combined. 
 All must deliver tangible outputs and a continuation or replication plan.

furtherInformation: VALLEYS aims to strengthen Knowledge Valorisation in Europe by building a Network of Knowledge Valorisation Intermediaries. 
 OC1 funds six-month pilots operationalising at least one ERA Code of Practice: 
 Strand A: Toolbox Integration Pilots, up to €10k, 
 Strand B: Cross-border Mobility and Secondments, up to €30k, two partners, 
 Strand C: Combined Approaches, up to €40k, two partners. 
 Budget €210,000 for up to 11 projects. Open to EU/Associated Countries. 
 Open from 14 Oct to 14 Dec 2026, 17:00 CET.
